from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
H,W,_ = im.shape
# classify each pixel
r,g,b = im[...,0].astype(int), im[...,1].astype(int), im[...,2].astype(int)
mx = np.maximum(np.maximum(r,g),b); mn = np.minimum(np.minimum(r,g),b)
sat = mx-mn
# categories
cat = np.full((H,W), '?')
cat[(mx<30)] = '#'           # black
cat[(sat<25)&(mx>=30)&(mx<90)] = '.'  # dark gray
cat[(sat<25)&(mx>=90)&(mx<160)] = '+' # mid gray
cat[(sat<25)&(mx>=160)] = 'o'         # light gray/white
cat[(r>110)&(g>80)&(b<140)&(r>=b)] = 'W'  # wood
cat[(b>r)&(sat>15)] = 'B'              # blueish
# downsample 2x2 mode-ish: take category at cell
for y in range(0,H,4):
    line=''
    for x in range(0,W,2):
        line += cat[y,x]
    print(line)
\"
